user.title: Add a PiPup TV
user.description: Enter the address of the Android TV running PiPup. The token is only needed if you have enabled authentication on the device.

zeroconf_confirm.title: Add a PiPup TV
zeroconf_confirm.description: A PiPup TV was discovered at {host}. Add it to Home Assistant? Enter a token only if authentication is enabled on the device.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach PiPup at that address.

abort.already_configured: This PiPup TV is already configured.

send.name: Send notification
send.description: Show a rich pop-up notification on a PiPup TV.

id.name: ID
id.description: Stable popup id. Re-sending with the same id updates the popup in place (a live stream keeps playing); also what Cancel targets.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Seconds before the notification auto-dismisses. 0 keeps it on screen until dismissed.

position.name: Position
position.description: Where on screen the notification appears. Positions 5–8 need PiPup 0.4.0 or newer.

tts.name: Text-to-speech
tts.description: Text to speak aloud on the TV.

sound.name: Sound
sound.description: "default" for the built-in chime, or the URL of a sound to play once.

image_uri.name: Image URL
image_uri.description: Image to show (URL or base64 data URI). Animated GIFs animate.

video_uri.name: Video / stream URL
video_uri.description: Video file or live HLS/RTSP stream to play.

media_width.name: Media width
media_width.description: Width of the media in pixels.

web_height.name: Web height
web_height.description: Older name for Media height; still works for web pages.

border_width.name: Border width
border_width.description: Border thickness in px (requires a border color).

urgency.name: Urgency
urgency.description: info / warning / critical — a blue / orange / red border preset.

muted.name: Muted
muted.description: Play video/web/WHEP/grid media without audio, so the popup never grabs audio focus. WHEP and grids are muted unless set to false.

buttons.name: Buttons
buttons.description: Up to 3 remote-operable buttons, each with an id and a label. Pressing one fires a pipup_button event and dismisses the popup.

button_text_color.name: Button text color
button_text_color.description: Button label color, [AA]RRGGBB; auto-contrasts when omitted.

icon_uri.name: Icon URI
icon_uri.description: Small leading icon (URL or base64 data URI).

show_progress.name: Show progress bar
show_progress.description: Show a countdown bar that drains over the duration.

replace.name: Replace
replace.description: Clear other pop-ups first instead of stacking.

callback.name: Callback URL
callback.description: URL that receives shown/dismissed/button POSTs. Leave empty when using buttons — Home Assistant wires this up and fires a pipup_button event.

media_position.name: Media position
media_position.description: Where media sits relative to the text: top, bottom, left, or right.

title_alignment.name: Title alignment
title_alignment.description: Align the title left, center, or right.

message_alignment.name: Message alignment
message_alignment.description: Align the message left, center, or right.

animation_type.name: Animation
animation_type.description: Entrance/exit animation: none, fade, slide, or scale.

animation_exit.name: Animate on exit
animation_exit.description: Also play the animation when the notification is dismissed.

fullscreen.name: Full screen
fullscreen.description: Fill the screen with the popup (media scaled to fit). Needs PiPup 0.5.0.

opacity.name: Opacity
opacity.description: Popup opacity from 0 to 1, so live TV shows through.

camera_entity.name: Camera
camera_entity.description: A Home Assistant camera to show. Home Assistant hands the TV a signed link to its own camera proxy (or HLS stream, or an uploaded snapshot), so the TV never needs the camera's address or password. A snapshot is used as the poster while the live view starts.

camera_mode.name: Camera mode
camera_mode.description: mjpeg (default): live MJPEG from Home Assistant's camera proxy. stream: HLS from the stream integration (needs it set up; a few seconds behind). snapshot: one still image, uploaded to the TV (no buttons).

whep_uri.name: WHEP URL
whep_uri.description: WebRTC stream from a WHEP endpoint such as go2rtc's /api/webrtc?src=STREAM; well under a second behind the camera. Needs PiPup 0.4.0.

grid.name: Camera grid
grid.description: Up to 9 WHEP streams shown as a grid: a list of URLs, or of items with uri, label and poster. All must come from the same go2rtc. Needs PiPup 0.5.0.

poster_uri.name: Poster URL
poster_uri.description: Still image shown while a video, web page or WHEP stream starts, faded out on its first frame.

poster_mode.name: Poster mode
poster_mode.description: How the poster fills the media box: fit, fill, stretch or center. When set, the box keeps its requested size instead of taking the poster's shape. Needs PiPup 0.5.0.

media_height.name: Media height
media_height.description: Height of web, WHEP or grid media in pixels.

buffer_ms.name: Buffer
buffer_ms.description: Video buffer in milliseconds. 150–300 cuts RTSP delay to about 1–2 s; raise it if the stream stutters. Needs PiPup 0.5.0.

decoder.name: Video decoder
decoder.description: auto, hardware or software. Software helps TVs whose hardware decoder is busy with live TV. Needs PiPup 0.5.0.

grid_columns.name: Grid columns
grid_columns.description: Columns in the camera grid (default: 2 up to 4 cameras, else 3).

grid_labels.name: Grid labels
grid_labels.description: Show each camera's label in the grid.

tts_language.name: Text-to-speech language
tts_language.description: BCP-47 language for the spoken text, e.g. nl-NL. Falls back to the TV's language.

sound_volume.name: Sound volume
sound_volume.description: Volume of the sound, 0 to 1. What the TV is playing ducks briefly.

dismiss_screensaver.name: End screensaver
dismiss_screensaver.description: End the TV's screensaver before showing the popup (default on).

dismiss.name: Dismiss notification
dismiss.description: Close a pop-up on a PiPup TV, or all of them.

id.name: ID
id.description: Id of the popup to close. Leave empty to close every popup.

overlay_permission.title: PiPup on {name} cannot show popups
overlay_permission.description:
PiPup on **{name}** is not allowed to display over other apps, so no popup can appear. Grant it on the TV (Settings > Apps > PiPup > Display over other apps), or from a computer with adb:

`{command}`

This notice clears itself once the TV reports the permission.
